'''The Exorcist Nurse!!''' (Japanese: '''お払いナース登場!!''' ''Enter the Exorcist Nurse!!'') is the fifty-ninth chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Plum]] and her senior, {{MPJ|Chansey}}, are new in town -- they're nurses who exorcise people's negative {{wp|qi}}. But they have their work cut out for them when they meet [[Peanut]]!
